recipes.title: Ordered agent run
signals: A conversation or ordered run is the primary object
Assistant, tool, permission, progress, and error events stream over time
A composer or command dock starts and continues work

concepts.title: Transcript first
concepts.primary_surface: Mixed-height run transcript with grouped tool and permission events
concepts.hero_interaction: Continue or stop the current run from an integrated command dock
concepts.narrow_behavior: Remove the conditional session rail, keep the transcript readable, and open event details as a drawer.
concepts.failure_risk: Becomes a generic chat shell when protocol events remain labeled cards instead of a designed transcript grammar.

concepts.title: Stage and progress first
concepts.primary_surface: Ordered stage list with the active step output and durable run progress
concepts.hero_interaction: Inspect, retry, cancel, or resume a concrete stage
concepts.narrow_behavior: Show one selected stage and its output; move the stage navigator and raw events into mutually exclusive drawers.
concepts.failure_risk: Misrepresents free-form conversation when the runtime has no stable stage model.

concepts.title: Artifact and change first
concepts.primary_surface: Durable file, diff, report, or result produced by the run
concepts.hero_interaction: Review and accept the produced change while the run remains contextual
concepts.narrow_behavior: Keep the artifact canvas and review action; collapse outline and run history into drawers.
concepts.failure_risk: Feels empty or dishonest when the run does not create a durable artifact.

recipes.title: Data and operations console
signals: Users scan, sort, filter, or compare many structured records
Selection drives contextual detail or actions
Density and terminal scrolling matter more than decorative cards

concepts.title: Table first
concepts.primary_surface: Dense sortable collection with stable columns and row selection
concepts.hero_interaction: Filter, select, and act on records without losing the scan position
concepts.narrow_behavior: Keep the grid horizontally viable and open row details as a full-height drawer.
concepts.failure_risk: Turns every row into a card and destroys comparison density.

concepts.title: Exception first
concepts.primary_surface: Prioritized queue of records that need attention
concepts.hero_interaction: Resolve the selected exception with visible evidence and consequences
concepts.narrow_behavior: Use queue and resolution as separate pages while preserving the current item identity.
concepts.failure_risk: Adds workflow ceremony when records are read-only or rarely need intervention.

concepts.title: Monitor first
concepts.primary_surface: Live operational state and trend changes
concepts.hero_interaction: Spot an abnormal state and drill into the responsible records
concepts.narrow_behavior: Keep critical status and one live scope; move scope selection and drilldown to transient pages.
concepts.failure_risk: Creates dashboard decoration when data is not actually live or comparable over time.

recipes.title: Document and artifact workbench
signals: Users create or review a durable document, file, diff, or structured artifact
The canvas must dominate while hierarchy and commands stay contextual
Selection or cursor position changes nearby tools

concepts.title: Canvas first
concepts.hero_interaction: Create, edit, or review the artifact without leaving the canvas
concepts.narrow_behavior: Keep one focused document; move outline and properties into mutually exclusive drawers.
concepts.failure_risk: Permanent tools crowd the canvas even when they have no selection-dependent meaning.

concepts.title: Structure first
concepts.primary_surface: Document hierarchy controlling a focused section editor
concepts.hero_interaction: Reorder or navigate structure while editing one selected section
concepts.narrow_behavior: Switch hierarchy and section editor as pages and keep the current section breadcrumb visible.
concepts.failure_risk: Overemphasizes hierarchy when the document is short or linear.

concepts.title: Review first
concepts.hero_interaction: Move through changes and accept, reject, or comment with context
concepts.narrow_behavior: Keep the active change and decision action; open queue and discussion as transient surfaces.
concepts.failure_risk: Adds review chrome to an ordinary authoring flow.

recipes.title: Focused desktop utility
signals: The workflow has one short durable outcome
Confidence, progress, recovery, and completion matter more than density

concepts.title: Guided flow
concepts.primary_surface: One current step with explicit progress and recovery
concepts.hero_interaction: Complete the current step and advance with confidence
concepts.narrow_behavior: Stack the current step and actions; keep help transient.
concepts.failure_risk: Introduces needless steps when the task can be completed on one surface.

concepts.title: Single canvas
concepts.primary_surface: One composed surface containing input, preview, and outcome
concepts.hero_interaction: Perform the primary action without changing context
concepts.narrow_behavior: Reflow the canvas vertically and preserve the primary action next to its outcome.
concepts.failure_risk: Becomes a featureless settings form when hierarchy and feedback are not composed.

concepts.title: Queue and completion
concepts.primary_surface: Small bounded list of items moving through one operation
concepts.hero_interaction: Add, start, cancel, retry, and verify completion
concepts.narrow_behavior: Keep the queue and progress; show item details as a drawer.
concepts.failure_risk: Uses a queue metaphor when only one item can ever exist.
